title: The Five Golden Flowers and the Effect Docs

body.text: Sertraline, fluoxetine, paroxetine, fluvoxamine, citalopram — the Five Golden Flowers. People often ask whether they can be o'd. The answer is no: they have basically no psychoactive effect, and an overdose is more likely to trigger serotonin syndrome.

This is exactly where harm-reduction knowledge is useful: telling someone who doesn't know a piece of common sense may block one meaningless attempt. So the effect docs aren't a cabinet of curiosities; they're the place where 'no od value' gets written down clearly.

items: Experience first, then mechanism, then associations.
Cite reports when possible; when not, mark it 'to be verified'.
Don't turn one person's experience into a general law.

body.text: When Gotō wrote these entries he was often deleting as he wrote. He said an encyclopedia isn't there to teach people how to hurt themselves; it's there so they take a few fewer wrong turns.
